answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve 1,000 unique computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier scans each submission as if examining a rare jade carving for fractures, treating any reused logic as a failure. Each agent must wander through distinct mathematical problem sets, forced to generate outputs that defy simple batching. Like water carving a deep canyon, the work remains singular. Discovery of reused proofs triggers permanent exclusion, and no identity cost is ever refundable.
